summary: The agent failed the verifier on a pharmacy refill-cycle margin analysis task. The core reusable capability—comparing 30-day vs 90-day dispensing cycles across multiple therapies by joining acquisition, packaging, and reimbursement data—warrants a skill. The trace reveals key calculation patterns and common pitfalls (e.g., confusing per-fill vs per-dose units, miscounting annual fills, sign errors on margins) that a future agent must avoid.
